name: run a focused test subset of a scientific package and iterate on the failing assertions
definition: Execute the relevant test file, interpret the failure, and adjust the source fix until targeted tests pass without disturbing other tests.
failure_mode: Fix breaks unrelated model compositions or fails the added cases

name: run a provided example script to confirm a successful install
definition: execute the given reference example under the venv and confirm it neither crashes nor throws and prints a success marker.
failure_mode: build/import errors in the example fail the run assertion
